# Compliance ticket for opi-q5k.12

Source check: opi-q5k.12 (overlay-options.test.ts audit)

## Work — add integration tests

These are integration-level. Use the pattern established in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/tui_render_test.exs (Renderer + VirtualTerminal) OR build a lightweight TUI test harness that mirrors `tui.showOverlay(...)` + render + `VT.get_viewport()`. Inspect the existing codebase first — if there is an Interactive/TUI GenServer with a showOverlay message API, use it; otherwise thread via Renderer + Overlay.composite.

Place tests in overlay_test.exs (extend existing file) or a new overlay_integration_test.exs — follow project convention.

### Width overflow protection (5 tests)

1. Overlay lines wider than declared width — composite result must not exceed declared width on any row.
2. Overlay content with complex ANSI (truecolor fg+bg + OSC 8 hyperlink) — render completes without crash.
3. Overlay composited on styled base (`\e[1m\e[38;2;255;0;0m` + "X"*width + reset) — overlay text visible in viewport.
4. Overlay containing wide CJK characters at declared-width boundary (width 15, content "中文日本語한글テスト漢字") — no crash.
5. Overlay positioned at terminal right edge (col 60, width 20, terminal 80 wide) — no crash.

### Row extremes (2 tests)

6. `row: "0%"` → overlay on row 0.
7. `row: "100%"` → overlay on last row (`height - overlay_height`, i.e., row 23 in 24-row terminal).

### Stacked overlays via showOverlay (3 tests)

8. Call showOverlay twice at same anchor; the second (top of stack) covers the first's overlapping cells. Verify viewport contains the second overlay's text on the overlapping row.
9. Two overlays at different anchors (top-left + bottom-right) — both visible in viewport.
10. After showing two overlays, call `hideOverlay()` → topmost removed, previously-covered one visible. Assert the first overlay's text is now on the row where the second had been.

### OSC 8 base content (already partly covered by existing "OSC 8 in base content does not crash" — verify it exercises the *overlay over base with hyperlink* path; if not, add a separate test with a base that renders `"See \\e]8;;file:///f.ts\\e\\f.ts\\e]8;;\\e\\\"` and an overlay at center — no crash and overlay visible.)

## Re-comparison (required)

After all tests land, re-read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/overlay-options.test.ts and confirm every `it(...)` block has an Elixir equivalent (many will map to existing overlay_test.exs tests; confirm those are sufficient or strengthen). Post a final comment here before closing.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.1 (acceptance gate).

comments.text: Done. 9 integration tests added via Overlay.composite. Hide-stack-order deliberately deferred to opi-q5k.36 (overlay focus subsystem) since our Overlay is a stateless compositing function, not a stateful lifecycle manager.
